_: Beat prose, keyed by CONCEPT LABEL and destination label - never by node id. Node ids renumber whenever the concept selection changes, and the selection is expected to change (connectivity-aware re-selection is queue item 3). Labels are unique in the shipped set because build-ontology.mjs rejects duplicate labels, so they are the stable key. build-story.mjs merges this in, so regenerating structure never destroys text. Follows docs/VOICE.md: depth is the clock, the double brackets mark a maskable concept, everything outside them is always visible. No quantities in prose (readouts.ts owns numbers). No word implying calibrated doubt - the game estimates no confidence, so machine output is unchecked, never unsure. Present tense: the player stands at the fork, never reads a report.

entity.title: Intake
entity.body: Everything is ⟦entity⟧ until we say otherwise. It is the one word nobody has asked us to check. Below it the work divides, and the division goes on file under your name.

physical entity.title: Signed Off Upstream
physical entity.body: ⟦physical entity⟧ was signed off before you arrived. Everything under it can be weighed, which is why we report on this side and not the other.

causal agent.title: Responsible For
causal agent.body: A ⟦causal agent⟧ is whatever produced the result. The record names the result. It does not name the producer, and nothing asks it to.

organism.title: Alive Or Filed As Alive
organism.body: ⟦organism⟧ is the line between alive and not. Below it the machines have been filing for longer than anyone here has been reading.

object.title: Counted Once
object.body: ⟦object⟧ is anything you can point at and count once. What sits below was made, and nothing filed says by whom.

whole.title: Parts, Counted Once
whole.body: A ⟦whole⟧ is parts counted once, on the understanding that nobody recounts. Below here the parts stop agreeing on what they belong to.

abstraction.title: Nothing To Weigh
abstraction.body: Nothing under ⟦abstraction⟧ can be lifted or weighed, so the machines file here fastest. Every way down is open. None of them is checked.

attribute.title: Held Against Nothing
attribute.body: An ⟦attribute⟧ is what a thing is like, held against nothing in particular. Two ways down are open and both are being filled while you stand here.

psychological feature.title: Inside Only
psychological feature.body: ⟦psychological feature⟧ holds what happens inside and leaves no trace outside. We file it anyway, at the same rate as everything else.

relation.title: Between Two Things
relation.body: A ⟦relation⟧ is not a thing. It is what sits between two of them, and it is filed as though it were a thing.

possession.title: Held By Someone
possession.body: ⟦possession⟧ is a thing with a holder attached. The holder is a field. Nothing checks it.

event.title: Something Happened
event.body: ⟦event⟧ means something happened. The record does not say to whom, and the machines are filing under it faster than anyone is reading.

group.title: Filed Together
group.body: A ⟦group⟧ is things filed together. Nothing requires them to share anything but the filing, and below here most of them do not.

social group.title: People, Filed
social group.body: A ⟦social group⟧ is people, filed. The filing outlives the people and keeps being served.

process.title: Still Running
process.body: A ⟦process⟧ has not finished, so nothing about it can be confirmed yet. It is filed as confirmed.

phenomenon.title: Observed, Not Explained
phenomenon.body: A ⟦phenomenon⟧ is something observed. Nothing under it is explained, and the record does not distinguish the two.

matter.title: What It Is Made Of
matter.body: ⟦matter⟧ is what a thing is made of, before anyone asks what it is for. One way down holds together. The others do not.

solid.title: Holds Its Shape
solid.body: ⟦solid⟧ holds its shape until something else acts on it. That is the whole definition, and it is the last one down here that fits on a line.

act.title: Someone Did It
act.body: An ⟦act⟧ is an event with someone behind it. The name of the someone is not a field.

activity.title: Kept Doing
activity.body: ⟦activity⟧ is an act that kept going. Nothing checks whether it should have. It continues below.

measure.title: Against A Scale
measure.body: ⟦measure⟧ is a thing held against a scale someone agreed on. The agreement is not filed here. Only the number is.

fundamental quantity.title: Measured By Itself
fundamental quantity.body: A ⟦fundamental quantity⟧ is measured against nothing but itself. Everything under it inherits that, whether or not it earns it.

definite quantity.title: Settled Already
definite quantity.body: A ⟦definite quantity⟧ is settled before anyone looks at it. Below here the settling stops matching what was settled.

shape.title: Outline Only
shape.body: ⟦shape⟧ is the outline and nothing inside it. Two ways down, and the graph no longer files them the way you were taught.

figure.title: Closed Outline
figure.body: A ⟦figure⟧ is a shape that closed. What is under it was closed by the graph, not by anyone. It continues either way.

magnitude relation.title: One Against Another
magnitude relation.body: A ⟦magnitude relation⟧ holds one size against another. Neither size is filed. Only the holding.

motivation.title: Why It Moved
motivation.body: ⟦motivation⟧ is why something moved. It is inferred and then stored as though it were observed.

information.title: Already Filed
information.body: ⟦information⟧ is what we hold once someone has written it down. Nobody here asks who wrote it. Everything under this was filed before you arrived and none of it is checked.

language.title: The Agreed Part
language.body: ⟦language⟧ is the part everyone agreed to use the same way. The agreement is not on file. Below it the agreement stops holding, one branch at a time.

agent.title: Whoever Does It
agent.body: An ⟦agent⟧ is whatever makes something happen. The word covers people and it covers machines, and nothing in the record separates the two. We consider that a feature.

system.title: Parts, Together
system.body: A ⟦system⟧ is parts arranged so the arrangement matters. Ours is arranged. What it is for is filed elsewhere.

power.title: Capacity To Act
power.body: ⟦power⟧ is the capacity to do a thing, held whether or not the thing is done. We report on the capacity.

communication.title: Sent, Not Read
communication.body: ⟦communication⟧ is anything sent from one place to another. Whether it arrived is a separate field, and the separate field is empty.

artificial language.title: Built On Purpose
artificial language.body: An ⟦artificial language⟧ was designed by someone, for something. That makes it the only kind down here whose rules were written before it was used.

natural language.title: Nobody Designed It
natural language.body: A ⟦natural language⟧ has rules nobody wrote and everybody follows. We are extracting them anyway. Progress is reported weekly.

metalanguage.title: About Itself
metalanguage.body: A ⟦metalanguage⟧ is a language for talking about a language. You are standing in one. So is everything above you.

sign language.title: Without Sound
sign language.body: A ⟦sign language⟧ carries everything the spoken ones carry and none of the sound. The pipeline ingests it as text, which loses the part that matters.

source language.title: What It Was Before
source language.body: A ⟦source language⟧ is what something was written in before we got it. What it is now is a translation, and the translation is what we file.

string of words.title: In Order
string of words.body: A ⟦string of words⟧ is words in an order. Whether the order means anything is not a field we keep.

synthetic language.title: Meaning In The Shape
synthetic language.body: A ⟦synthetic language⟧ folds the grammar into the word itself, so the shape of a thing tells you its job. You have been reading one.

actor.title: The One Acting
actor.body: An ⟦actor⟧ is whoever is doing it. Everything under here is a way of being someone, and the machines have filed all of them the same way.

collection.title: Gathered
collection.body: A ⟦collection⟧ is things somebody gathered. The gathering is the only thing they have in common and it is not recorded.

people.title: In The Plural
people.body: ⟦people⟧ is the plural we use when we are not naming anyone. Most of the graph below this point is that.

written communication.title: It Persists
written communication.body: ⟦written communication⟧ outlasts whoever sent it, which is why we prefer it. It also outlasts whoever meant it.

visual communication.title: Seen, Not Said
visual communication.body: ⟦visual communication⟧ works without a sentence. We store it as one anyway.

acknowledgment.title: Receipt
acknowledgment.body: An ⟦acknowledgment⟧ says a thing arrived. It says nothing about what was done with it, and we count it as done.

ethnic group.title: Held Apart
ethnic group.body: An ⟦ethnic group⟧ is people the record holds apart from other people. The record does not say who decided, and the decision is inherited by everything below.

offer.title: Put Forward
offer.body: An ⟦offer⟧ is a thing put forward and not yet taken. The graph keeps it in that state indefinitely.

indication.title: Points At Something
indication.body: An ⟦indication⟧ points at a thing without being the thing. Almost everything we hold is one of these.

message.title: The Part Sent
message.body: A ⟦message⟧ is the part that was sent, separated from whoever sent it. We keep the part. The rest is not a field.
